value.body: Architectural visualisers turn drawings into realistic images and walkthroughs used for design reviews, approvals and property marketing. They work in visualisation studios, architecture firms and real-estate marketing agencies, some of which serve overseas clients. The day is spent modelling, lighting and rendering scenes, then revising them.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Arch, B.Des, or a 3D / animation course

items.label: Common tools
items.value: SketchUp, 3ds Max, real-time rendering engines, Photoshop

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hiring is portfolio-driven: a few strong renders of interiors and exteriors matter more than the degree. Many B.Arch graduates move into this after a short rendering course or freelance work.

value.title: At a glance
items: Deadlines often cluster around client presentations and project launches.
Freelance work is common once a portfolio is established.
Next steps: senior visualiser, visualisation lead, or real-time / VR work.
